messages.content: sprout example compiles but the window is black on macOS, any ideas?
are you calling sp_clear every frame? on macOS the first frame is undefined until you do
that was it, thank you!
how do I load a sprite sheet and cut it into frames?
sp_load the sheet, then sp_sub(sheet, x, y, w, h) for each frame. examples/walk.c does exactly that.
found it, works
